title: Faisal Town Islamabad Map & Location | Phase 1 & Phase 2
description: Find the location of Faisal Town Phase 1/F-18 and Phase 2/FT-II, understand Google Maps and project plans, and verify a plot before visiting.
intro: Faisal Town Phase 1 / F-18 and Phase 2 / FT-II are separate project areas. Confirm the project first, then request the exact property pin and a marked block or sector plan before arranging your visit.
body:
## Faisal Town Phase 1 and Phase 2 are different locations

Start with the full project name when requesting directions. A pin or map for one phase should never be used to verify a property in the other.

## Faisal Town Phase 1 / F-18 location

Phase 1 / F-18 uses Blocks A, B and C. Ask for the relevant block, street and property number, along with a current location pin and an agreed meeting point.

## Faisal Town Phase 2 / FT-II location

Phase 2 / FT-II uses sector names. Confirm the sector and exact plot number before asking for directions. Request the currently accessible approach and a meeting point for your visit; a sector label alone is not enough to locate a plot.

## Google Maps and project plans answer different questions

Google Maps helps with external routes and navigation to a shared location pin. A project plan explains internal blocks, sectors, streets and plot positions. Compare both with the property documents and the actual site.

## How to locate a specific plot

Confirm the project, then the sector or block, plot number and size. Request a marked plan and compare it with the property documents. Use a site visit or live video to verify the location and access.

## What to check during a site visit

Check road access, street identification, plot demarcation, nearby construction and the current condition of the surroundings. Confirm where the exact plot starts and ends. Planned roads and facilities may differ from what is accessible today.
bulletsText:
Name the project first | Start with Phase 1/F-18 or Phase 2/FT-II before discussing a block or sector.
Ask for exact plot number | A sector name alone is not enough for location verification.
Use the correct plan | Full master plan for orientation; sector plan for detailed plot position where available.
Compare with the site | Use a current visit or live video to verify practical access and development.

faqsText:
Is Faisal Town Phase 1 the same location as Phase 2? | No. They are separate project areas and should be reviewed with their own maps and page structure.
Where can I open the Phase 2 master plan? | Use the Phase 2 master plan guide or download the PDF linked from this site.
Can the master plan confirm availability? | No. It shows layout and location context. Current availability must be checked separately.
Should I use Google Maps or the project plan? | Use both. Google Maps helps with external routes; the project plan helps with internal sector and plot context.
What do I need to verify one plot? | Project, sector/block, plot number, size, marked map location and a current site or video check.
